about: Baseline sounds every studio clip needs, generated once with ElevenLabs and stored in assets/sfx (loudness-normalised mono wav). Authorised by the user on 2026-11-08. Each film adds its own list in episodes/<id>/audio/effects.json. Loops are for ambience beds. The survival kit (cart, toy, crash, zombie, drone, jeep, dawn sounds) was added 2026-11-08 at the owner request ("generate effects so we can reuse them").
